description: Search the US API Catalogue open data catalogue (data.gov-harvested index of 4,290 API datasets) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "health": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: US API Catalogue. License: Public domain (U.S. federal government).
